The structure of Dy4Ge8Pt8 (reduced formula DyGe2Pt2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers with 15 geometric neighbors (2 Dy, 4 Ge, 9 Pt), Ge centers with 9 neighbors (2 Dy, 1 Ge, 6 Pt), and Pt centers with 9 neighbors (2 Dy, 1 Ge, 6 Pt). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 15-vertex Dy and 9-vertex Ge and Pt polyhedra.
